Policy I: two independent whole-problem constructors, followed by lead synthesis. Policy C: backward capability analysis and two complementary constructive roles, followed by lead synthesis. Both permit strong expert reasoning, existing machinery, original constructions, ordinary comparisons and critical testing. No dedicated critic displaces a constructor. This tests a complete coordination package, not exclusive access to first-principles thinking.
